title: example 105 replay (Phase 5): commons-numbers pow, before deviates from the Javadoc's contract at (-2, 31) alone and after meets it, from each commit's Maven build
description: The job runs python3 examples/tools/build.py 105 --task replay, the target route of llm-dlc/loops/example-targets.md: workflow plans the task from target.json, runtime prepares each revision (every pinned file acquired by the sha256 its sidecar records, refused on a mismatch; driver and adapter compiled with --release 21), runs the packet's driver over its probes in a separate JVM per revision on JDK 21 and on JDK 25, and workflow ingests the records into one format-2 receipt, reading each revision's driver lines with the packet's independent oracle (controls/oracle.py problems()). A replay decides no claim: build.py exits 0 only when the receipt's matchesExpected is true, i.e. every revision ran on both JDKs, exited 0 with structured observations, and each shows what its pair's kind expects on both JDKs alike. No proof runs. Example 105 (commons-numbers pull request 223, ArithmeticUtils.pow(int,int)), the calibration packet: runtime prepares before (e7c172d2) and after (8cfc04e8) by the upstream-build route, each commit checked out from github.com and built with Maven 3.10.0 on JDK 11 (dependencies from Maven Central, every resolved file hashed), then the driver runs replay/probes.json's 75 probes, every point of the fix-property domain, on JDK 21 and 25. Its two proof tasks already passed gate A5 (jobs 20261114-215343 and 20261114-215345, established and refuted with the witness (-2, 31)); this is the concrete replay task on its own receipt, which those proof receipts don't carry (ingestion bundles no raw streams).
expected: build.py prints '105-...: task replay: none (completed; as expected)' and exits 0: before violates the oracle at (-2, 31) alone (ArithmeticException), after shows no problem, on JDK 21 and 25 alike; a receipt under examples/105-*/receipts/replay/

resources.notes: two shallow github.com fetches of commons-numbers and two Maven builds on JDK 11 (runtime's job 20261114-174017 built both in 59 s with a warm cache), four short JVM runs
